# .github/requirements-clang-format.txt
#
# clang-format pin for CI, installed via pip so the formatter version does not
# depend on the runner image. Pinned here so Dependabot can track and propose
# version updates (picked up by the `pip` ecosystem in .github/dependabot.yml).
#
# Kept apart from .github/requirements.txt so a clang-format update only
# triggers, and can only break, the formatting workflow.
#
# Used by:
#   - .github/workflows/validate_clang_format.yml

clang-format==23.1.3
